g:description.p:
What are the benefits?
Boosts focus, willpower, and discipline for goal achievement.
Enhances immunity and overall well-being.
Shields from negativity, ensuring clarity and peace.
Attracts success and prosperity in all areas.

How to wear?
Soak in water or raw milk for purification.
Wear on Thursday morning after a bath for willpower and protection.
Chant "Om Hreem Hum Namah" 11 times to activate its energy.
Use silver, gold, or silk thread for best results.
Keep clean, avoiding soap and chemicals.

Best day to wear
The new moon is ideal for new beginnings, setting intentions, and energizing gemstones/Rudraksha, aligning them with the universe’s flow.
